title: A new model may take the sealed exams Claude took, once, named apart and marked not unseen
request: The owner chose to rerun the old sealed sets with Qwen as a one-time exception, then write new sealed sets.
plan: Wire it into the conversation exam, Home and the journeys, where Claude took sealed sets.

decisions.decision: The exception is asked for in words and refused for Claude
decisions.why: a rerun is not unseen (DCLab was tuned after reading those results); it must never pass silently as a first sealed verdict

decisions.decision: Reruns are named <RUN>_<split>_rerun_<model> and carry unseen false
decisions.why: the comparison reads them beside Claude's first runs and the benchmark shows them apart

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/sealed.py; conversation_exam/__init__.py; home/__main__.py and __init__.py; journeys/__main__.py and __init__.py; tests/test_sealed_rerun.py.

findings.defect: A widened sealed-run match would count other sets' files
findings.scenario: matching HOME-*_sealed*.json for split sealed also matched sealed_v5 and sealed_v6
findings.fix: an exact pattern: the split, optionally followed by _rerun_<model>

findings.defect: Claude served through OpenRouter was not refused
findings.scenario: an anthropic/claude-sonnet id passed the exception
findings.cause: the check read only a claude- prefix
findings.fix: any model name containing claude is refused

findings.defect: The journeys accepted a rerun where no model plays
findings.scenario: --model-rerun on a rules-only sealed set stored a rules result credited to Qwen and used up the rerun
findings.cause: the rerun path did not require a model's arms
findings.fix: --model-rerun needs --reader or --team-arms; the result names its model

findings.defect: A failed Home rerun blocked every retry
findings.scenario: an unscored rerun file matched the already-reran check
findings.cause: the check's glob also matched _unscored files
findings.fix: the check reads scored sealed runs only

outcome: Without the exception a spent sealed set is refused as before; with it, a new model reruns it once and the result is named apart.
lessons: When a rule gains an exception, check the old matching still sees exactly the files it saw before.
risks: Analyst, investigator, map and built-chat sealed sets are not wired yet.
